title: A Daily Routine
summary: A woman describes her weekday routine and contrasts it with yesterday.

paragraphs.pt: Todos os dias, Camila acorda às seis horas. Ela toma banho, prepara café e pega o ônibus para o trabalho. No escritório, responde e-mails e conversa com os clientes pelo celular. Gosta da rotina, mas sonha em ter manhãs menos corridas.
paragraphs.en: Every day, Camila wakes up at six o'clock. She takes a shower, makes coffee, and takes the bus to work. At the office, she answers emails and talks with customers by cell phone. She likes the routine, but dreams of having less rushed mornings.

paragraphs.pt: Ontem foi diferente. O ônibus atrasou, e Camila chegou vinte minutos depois. Ela tinha que entregar um relatório importante antes das cinco. No começo, ficou nervosa, mas seu colega Diego trouxe café e ajudou a revisar os números.
paragraphs.en: Yesterday was different. The bus was late, and Camila arrived twenty minutes later. She had to deliver an important report before five. At first, she got nervous, but her colleague Diego brought coffee and helped review the numbers.

paragraphs.pt: Com a ajuda de Diego, Camila terminou o relatório no prazo. À noite, voltou para casa cansada, colocou água na geladeira e fez uma sopa simples. Antes de dormir, escreveu na agenda: “Sair dez minutos mais cedo e agradecer ao Diego.”
paragraphs.en: With Diego's help, Camila finished the report on time. At night, she returned home tired, put water in the refrigerator, and made a simple soup. Before sleeping, she wrote in her planner: “Leave ten minutes earlier and thank Diego.”

comprehension.question: How does Camila go to work?
What did she finish before five?
What did Camila do before sleeping?
